---
title: "Layout panels"
format:
  emiljs:
    keep-emiljs: true
_quarto:
  tests:
    emiljs:
      noErrorsOrWarnings: []
      ensureHtmlElements:
        - ['div.columns > div.column', 'figure']
      ensureEmiljsFileRegexMatches:
        # a plain panel maps onto emil.js columns, widths as bare numbers (A13)
        - ['::: \{\.column width="50(\.0)?"\}', '\nLeft \{\.caption\}\n', '\n\(a\).First \{\.caption\}\n', 'Figure.1: Panel caption\. \{\.caption\}',
            # layout-nrow: one columns row per row, the parent caption after the last
            '\n\(a\).One \{\.caption\}\n(.|\n)*\n\(b\).Two \{\.caption\}\n(.|\n)*Figure.2: Nrow caption\. \{\.caption\}',
            # layout matrix: rows of columns with relative widths
            '::: \{\.column width="70(\.0)?"\}', '::: \{\.column width="30(\.0)?"\}', '\n\(c\).Full \{\.caption\}\n(.|\n)*Figure.3: Matrix caption\. \{\.caption\}']
        - ['width="50(\.0)?%"', 'ref-parent', 'quarto-layout', 'layout']
---
